action_items: Backend lane not applicable: acceptance matrix specifies React session state only and no API/database behavior; pytest exited 5 because no tests are defined. /api/health is also not implemented (404), but no app flow calls it.

checks.criterion: Profil dan alur belajar tetap berjalan tanpa data sensitif
checks.name: profile-and-learning-flow
checks.evidence: Profile form accepted optional nickname and 2–3 tahun; empty-age validation displayed; /belajar rendered exactly 10 module cards.

checks.criterion: Detail materi gizi menampilkan infografik pengguna dengan benar
checks.name: nutrition-infographic-mobile
checks.evidence: Nutrition infographic rendered on 390px viewport with alt text covering carbohydrate, animal/plant protein, vegetables, fruit, fat, and water; no page horizontal overflow.

checks.criterion: Referensi menampilkan tabel AKG resmi sebagai acuan kelompok
checks.name: references-akg-responsive
checks.evidence: References rendered 3 AKG rows, values 1.350/1.400 kkal, 20/25 g protein, 45/50 g fat, 215/220 g carbohydrate, mapping note, PDF link, and non-individual disclaimer.

checks.criterion: Layout referensi responsif di desktop dan mobile
checks.name: reference-desktop-layout
checks.evidence: Desktop reference list and AKG card were visible with mapping note and no document horizontal overflow; mobile responsive assertions passed in references-akg-responsive.

checks.criterion: Susun Piringku dan Switch Camilan tetap berfungsi
checks.name: plate-and-snack-interactions
checks.evidence: Empty plate validation displayed; food selections evaluated non-diagnostically, reset cleared selections; snack try choice showed positive feedback and next example advanced.

checks.criterion: Kuis, skenario, dan checklist higiene tetap berfungsi
checks.name: quiz-scenario-hygiene-flow
checks.evidence: 8 quiz answers produced feedback and completion score; scenario option produced discussion; all 5 hygiene checks produced completion message.

checks.criterion: Ringkasan menampilkan infografik progres dan lima pengingat
checks.name: summary-progress-reminders
checks.evidence: Progress infographic with badge alt text, exactly 5 reminders, primary home CTA, and references link rendered.

checks.criterion: Tidak ada error runtime atau masalah akses dasar pada route utama
checks.name: main-routes-no-overflow
checks.evidence: Home plus /belajar, /piringku, /camilan, /kuis, /skenario, /higiene, /ringkasan, and /referensi opened with main content visible at mobile width and no horizontal overflow.
